title: KIKIORI user guide
intro: KIKIORI helps you capture field knowledge through conversation. Start with the three steps below: prepare, talk, and confirm.

quickStart.title: Your first 3 steps
quickStart.summary: Prepare a knowledge area, talk with KIKO, then review the result before using it as knowledge.

steps.title: Prepare a knowledge area
steps.description: Create a topic, then set the interview flow and question fields.

steps.title: Talk with KIKO
steps.description: Name your record and answer KIKO's questions by text or voice.

steps.title: Review the result
steps.description: Read the AI-organized content, correct what is needed, and confirm it.

start.title: Start here
start.description: Learn what KIKIORI and KIKO do so the rest of the app is easier to understand.

core.title: The basics

sections.title: About KIKIORI
sections.summary: KIKIORI organizes conversations with AI and keeps the content people have reviewed as shared knowledge.

sections.title: About KIKO
sections.summary: KIKO is the AI assistant that asks questions, organizes the conversation, and points out items to review.
sections.tip: Do not confirm an AI suggestion without checking it. A person reviews the content before it becomes knowledge.

sections.title: 1. Create and set up knowledge
sections.summary: A knowledge area is the place for one topic. Set its purpose and questions before interviewing.
steps: In the knowledge list, select New knowledge and enter a name and purpose.
Set the flow in Interview settings and arrange the fields in Question settings.
Save the settings and check that the interview is ready to start.

sections.title: 2. Create a record and start
sections.summary: Create a record for one conversation, then start the interview with KIKO.
steps: Open the knowledge area and select Start interview.
Enter a record title and select Start new interview.
If you leave partway through, open the record from the interview list to resume later.

sections.title: 3. Talk with KIKO
sections.summary: Read KIKO's questions and answer by text or voice. More detail helps organize the result.
steps: Read the question, enter a specific answer in the composer, and send it.
For voice interviews, start voice input and speak naturally.
Include extra context when you want to explain or add to an answer.
sections.tip: If a question is unclear, say what you know and why you cannot answer instead of guessing.

sections.title: 4. Review the record and extracted content
sections.summary: Compare the organized items with the original questions and answers.
steps: Open the knowledge panel on the interview screen. On a smartphone, select the knowledge button.
Read each item waiting for review and compare it with the original answer.
Open the record and add information if something is missing.

sections.title: 5. Correct and confirm knowledge
sections.summary: Fix mistakes, check the result, and confirm it as official knowledge.
steps: Read the field name, description, and answer, then choose edit for anything that needs a correction.
Save the correction and check that no items are still waiting for review.
Confirm the content when it is ready.
sections.tip: If you have permission, you can review and update confirmed knowledge later.

sections.title: Review analysis
sections.summary: Use the admin dashboard to understand usage and find records that need attention.
steps: Open the admin dashboard from the knowledge list, then choose a period and knowledge area.
Review knowledge, record, answer, and pending-review counts to understand overall progress.
Check trends and learning status in the analysis tabs, then open priority records when follow-up is needed.
sections.tip: The admin dashboard is available to administrators and knowledge managers.

sections.title: Choose a screen or knowledge area
sections.summary: Use the navigation to choose the knowledge area and screen you need.
steps: Select a knowledge name to open its interview screen.
Switch between records, settings, and the knowledge list from navigation.
On a smartphone, open navigation from the menu button at the top of the screen.

sections.title: Find knowledge
sections.summary: Use names and tags in the knowledge list to move to the information you need.
steps: Check the name, purpose, tags, and last updated time in the knowledge list.
Expand or collapse tag groups in navigation to find a knowledge area.

sections.title: Change the display language
sections.summary: Switch KIKIORI's display language from the user menu.
steps: Open the user area at the bottom of the sidebar and select Display language.
Choose 日本語, English, 简体中文, or ไทย to update the interface.

faq.question: How do I resume an interview?
faq.answer: Open the knowledge area and select a record from the interview list. A record in progress resumes from where you left off.

faq.question: Can I confirm AI-organized content immediately?
faq.answer: Review it first. Correct any errors, then save and confirm only after the content has been checked.

faq.question: How can I see where an action is on screen?
faq.answer: Select Start interactive guide on this page or in the user menu on the original KIKIORI screen.
